configs_panel.auto_complete_tooltip: When enabled, the canvas will be automatically extended to align with the pixel grid, filling any empty spaces with transparent pixels. This ensures that each pixel block is rendered completely, regardless of the source image's size.
configs_panel.picker_switch_to_pencil_tooltip: When enabled, the picker tool will switch to the last used tool after picking a color, allowing for immediate painting.
